name: Weak Cosmic Amoeba
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-17: Stranded on Yesterday's Tide

generalAbilities.name: Motion Sense
generalAbilities.description: A cosmic amoeba can sense nearby creatures through vibration and air or water movement.

defensiveAbilities.name: No Breath
defensiveAbilities.description: The cosmic amoeba doesn't breathe and is immune to effects that require breathing (such as inhaled poison).

offensiveAbilities.name: Constrict
offensiveAbilities.description:
1d4+2 bludgeoning plus 1 acid, DC 17 basic Fortitude save

See rules...

The monster deals the listed amount of damage to any number of creatures Grabbed or Restrained by it. Each of those creatures can attempt a basic Fortitude save with the listed DC.

offensiveAbilities.name: Envelop
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The cosmic amoeba begins its turn with a target its size or smaller Grabbed

Effect The cosmic amoeba maintains the Grab and extends pseudopods to surround the creature and pull it inside the amoeba's body. This thereafter has the same effect as if the amoeba had Engulfed the creature (DC 17 Reflex save, 1d6 acid, Escape DC 17, Rupture 3).

offensiveAbilities.name: Weak Acid
offensiveAbilities.description: A cosmic amoeba's acid damages only organic material—not metal, stone, or other inorganic substances.

description: These blobs of nearly transparent protoplasm are identical in form and behavior to the microscopic creatures from which they have evolved, except their outlandish size makes them all the more dangerous. Unlike slimes, puddings, and other deadly oozes, giant amoebas have an outer membrane that contains their internal structures, making them more susceptible to slashing weapons than their amorphous kin. However, this membrane is also extremely flexible and permeable, allowing them to surround prey and absorb it, suffocating and slowly digesting it in the amoeba's acidic fluids.
